user.title: YoLink User Access Credentials
user.description: In the YoLink app go to Settings > Account > Advanced Settings > User Access Credentials, tap + if none exist, and copy the UAID and Secret Key.

hub.title: Choose the hub
hub.description: Hubs already set up aren't listed. Add the integration again for each other hub; the same UAID and Secret Key work for every hub on the account.

local.title: {hub}: local check and polling
local.description: Enter the hub's LAN IP address so Home Assistant can ping it directly. This tells a local hub outage apart from an internet or YoLink cloud outage, and when the ping result changes the YoLink cloud is checked right away. Leave it empty to skip the local check.

data.local_host: Hub IP address on your network

error.invalid_auth: YoLink rejected the UAID or Secret Key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the YoLink cloud. Try again.
error.no_hubs: No hub was found on this YoLink account.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.all_hubs_configured: Every hub on this YoLink account is already set up.

data.local_host: Hub IP address on your network (empty = no local check)

state.offline_cloud_lan_ok: Offline in cloud, reachable on LAN
state.cloud_down_lan_ok: YoLink cloud unreachable, hub reachable on LAN
state.cloud_down_lan_down: YoLink cloud and hub both unreachable
